about: The chapter heading names Christ's entry into Jerusalem in glory, and the text answers with a chain of prophecies in the frame "and as X prophesied and said": Isaiah, Zechariah, David, Solomon and Ezra, then Jacob's blessing of Judah (the son of a lion, the lordship that does not depart). The author then explains that "Beloved", "Messiah" and "Jesus" all name Christ, cites the Ascension of Isaiah and the psalms of the unicorn's horn, and ends with Habakkuk's "horns in his hands" read as the nails of the cross.

sentences.i: Chapter 107: Concerning the entry into Jerusalem in glory
sentences.n: Chapter heading. በአቱ is በአት 'entry, entering' (from ቦአ 'enter') + -ሁ 'his': the ending is the suffix -ቱ, not the construct ending -ተ, so literally 'his entry, Jerusalem', the suffix anticipating the place, and the sense is 'the entry into Jerusalem' (?). The reference is Christ's entry into Jerusalem, as the prophecies below make clear. በስብሐት is በ- 'in' + ስብሐት 'glory, praise'.

And-as prophesied David and-said: 'From-mouth-of children and-infants you-prepared(?) praise on-account-of enemy, that you-bring-down(?)-him the-enemy and-the-oppressor.' And-as prophesied Solomon and-said: 'Children-your taught in-the-presence-of God, and-will-rejoice nations within-you(f).' And-as prophesied David father-his and-said: 'Blow-you(pl) horn in-Zion on-day-of rising, on-marked day feast-our, for ordinance-his for-Israel it.' And-as prophesied Ezra scribe and-said: 'Go-out-you(pl), make-you(pl) feast in-gladness, and-say(pl)-to-her to-daughter-of Zion: Rejoice-you(f), behold king-your(f) has-arrived.' And-as prophesied Isaiah prophet and-said: 'Rejoice-you(f) Jerusalem, rejoice-you(f), behold king-your(f) has-arrived, while he-rides upon ass, he-whose-reward with-him and-work-his before face-his.' And-as prophesied David prophet and-said: 'Blessed he-who comes in-name-of God.'
sentences.i: And concerning the entry into Jerusalem in glory the prophets prophesied, Isaiah the prophet saying: 'Shine, shine, Jerusalem! Your light has come, and the glory of God has risen over you.' And as Zechariah the prophet prophesied and said: 'Rejoice, rejoice, daughter of Zion, and let Jerusalem exult in joy.' And as David prophesied and said: 'Out of the mouth of children and infants you have prepared praise, because of the enemy, that you may bring down the enemy and the oppressor.' And as Solomon prophesied and said: 'Your children are taught in the presence of God, and the nations will rejoice within you.' And as his father David prophesied and said: 'Blow the horn in Zion on the day of the rising (?), on the appointed day of our feast, for it is his ordinance for Israel.' And as Ezra the scribe prophesied and said: 'Go out, make a feast with gladness, and say to the daughter of Zion: Rejoice! Behold, your king has come.' And as Isaiah the prophet prophesied and said: 'Rejoice, Jerusalem, rejoice! Behold, your king has come, riding on an ass, he whose reward is with him and whose work is before his face.' And as David the prophet prophesied and said: 'Blessed is he who comes in the name of God.'
sentences.n: This long unit has no ፤ or ። inside it, so it is kept whole as cut by script. It opens a catena of prophecy for Christ's entry into Jerusalem (the Palm Sunday scene), strung on the frame ወበከመ ተነበየ X ወይቤ 'and as X prophesied and said' (ወ- 'and', በ- + ከመ 'as'; perfect ተነበየ, tä-stem of n-b-y). The quotations and their sources: Isaiah 60:1 ('Shine, Jerusalem, your light has come'; አብርሂ is the feminine imperative, -ኪ the feminine 'your'); Zechariah 9:9 ('Rejoice, daughter of Zion'); Psalm 8:2 (the mouths of children and infants, quoted in Matthew 21:16 at this very entry); ምሁራን 'taught, trained' recalls Isaiah 54:13 (children taught by God), which the text gives to Solomon, and the 'nations rejoicing in you' is a different verse again, so this is a loose citation; Psalm 81:3 (80:4 in the Septuagint), the horn blown on the feast, given to 'David his father'; Ezra the scribe is credited with a saying that echoes Nehemiah 8 and Zechariah 9:9, not a verse I can match (?); then Isaiah again with the king on an ass (Zechariah 9:9, with 'his reward is with him and his work before him' from Isaiah 40:10 / 62:11); and Psalm 118:26 (117:26), 'Blessed is he who comes in the name of God', which the crowds cry in Matthew 21:9. Source slip kept as printed: ን ፡ ጉሥኪ is one word, ንጉሥኪ 'your king', split by a stray wordspace (ንጉሥኪ is spelled whole earlier in this unit). Uncertain: ሠርቅ 'rising' (sunrise, new moon?) in 'day of the rising' (?); እምርት is 'sign, mark', so 'marked/appointed day'; ወበልዋ is ወ- + the 2mp imperative በሉ + the suffix -ዋ 'to her' (compare በልዎሙ in ch. 106c), 'and say to her', continuing the plural ፃኡ ግበሩ. Further forms to watch: ወየብቢ — I cannot identify the root; 'exult, cry out' is guessed from Zechariah 9:9, and a 2fs imperative would not normally carry የ- (?). አስተዳሎከ is either 'you prepared' (2ms perfect, contracted) or 'he prepared for you' (3ms + -ከ) (?); the Psalm's sense favours the first. ትንሥቶ is a 2ms subjunctive + -ኦ 'him' (doubled by ለጸላኢ); 'bring down' is guessed from the sense, the root being uncertain (?). ወለገፋዒ: ገፋዒ is the agent noun of ገፍዐ 'push, oppress', so 'oppressor' (?). ሥርዐቱ is ሥርዐት 'ordinance' + -ሁ 'his'. በኀበ is 'before, in the presence of'. ዘዕሴቱ 'he whose reward' is ዘ- 'who/whose' + ዕሴት 'reward' + -ሁ.

sentences.i: and lordship will not fail from Judah, nor rule from his limbs (?), until he finds what is fixed for him (?); and he is the hope of the nations.
sentences.n: Genesis 49:10, the lordship that does not leave Judah. ምልክና 'lordship, dominion' (the published ch. 43 has ምልክናሁ) and ምስፍና 'rule, governorship' are both abstract nouns in -ና, and here neither carries a suffix, so not 'your lordship'. አባል is 'limb, member' (as in the published parts); the Hebrew has 'from between his feet', so 'limbs' here probably means the body from which descendants come (?). ይረክብ ዘጽኑሕ ሎቱ is literally 'he finds that which is firm for him': ጽኑሕ is 'firm, abiding' (as in ch. 2–8), so 'what is fixed for him'; whose it is and what it is remain uncertain (?). The last clause, 'and he is the hope of the nations', is the Christian reading of the verse.

sentences.i: And again he prophesied and said: 'His teeth are white like hail (?), and his eyes are glad like wine, and he washes his garment in wine, and his robe in the blood of the grape-cluster.' And again he prophesied, saying: 'Judah, son of a lion, you lay down and slept; there is no one who wakes him but himself, until he finds the one who prevailed (?);
sentences.n: Genesis 49:12 and 49:9. The two ወካዕበ ተነበየ 'and again he prophesied' (ካዕበ 'again, a second time') mark that the same patriarch is quoted a second and third time. በረድ is 'hail, ice' (the Hebrew and Greek have 'milk' for the teeth), so 'white like hail' (?). ፍሡሓት 'glad, bright' is a feminine plural adjective on አዕይንት 'eyes'. ሶንዶኖ is the Greek loanword σινδών 'linen cloth, robe' with the suffix -ኦ; አስካል is 'cluster of grapes'. In the second quotation ሰከብከ ወኖምከ is 'you lay down and slept' (Genesis 49:9); ዘያነቅሆ 'who wakes him' is ዘ- + ያነቅሆ (ʾa-stem of n-q-h 'be awake'). ዘነዐወ is, I think, 'he who prevailed' (ነዐወ 'conquer', the verb of the Lion of Judah in Revelation 5:5), but this is uncertain (?). እስከ ይረክብ ዘነዐወ repeats the previous unit's ይረክብ ዘ-: I take the ዘ-clause as what he finds; the other possibility, 'until he who prevailed attains (it)', has the ዘ-clause as subject (?).

sentences.n: Genesis 49:9–12 continues, Judah the lion's whelp. ሕዛእት (here with the preposition እም- and -ከ) I take as 'shoot, sprout' (?). ዕርግ is the 2ms imperative of ዐርገ 'go up' (or possibly a noun 'ascent'), not a perfect 'you went up' (?). ባረኮ is the perfect ባረከ 'bless' plus -ኦ 'him', doubled by ለይሁዳ; ወልዲ is, in the published parts' spelling, 'his son' (-ዲ for -ሁ), so ያዕቆብ is the subject placed last, 'Jacob blessed Judah, his son'; the other reading, ወልዲ as 'son of' ('Judah son of Jacob', with the blesser unnamed), is possible (?). ወይቤሎ is 'and he said to him'. ህሎ ንጉሥ 'there is a king' (ህሎ 'there is/was'). ምዕራፍ is 'resting-place' (from ዐረፈ 'rest'), as in the published parts (?), so 'his resting-place is honoured'. ለፍቁር 'for the Beloved' is a Christian addition to the verse: ፍቁር 'beloved' (from ፈቀረ 'love') is the title the next units explain. The ፤ ends mid-sentence; the explanation of ፍቁር follows.

sentences.i: The prophets, for their part, name Christ in secret and call him 'the Beloved'. And Isaiah said, in a prophecy about his ascension: 'On that day the Beloved will come down from heaven and choose for himself twelve apostles;
sentences.n: The enclitic -ሰ in ወነቢያትሰ marks contrast ('the prophets, for their part, ...'). ይሰምይዎ and ይብልዎ are 3mp imperfects with the suffix -ዎ 'him' (ሰመየ 'name', ብህለ 'say'; ይብልዎ ፍቁር 'they say of him, Beloved', i.e. call him). በሥውር 'in secret' (ሥውር 'hidden'); ለክርስቶስ marks the object and is doubled by the suffix -ዎ ('name him, Christ'). ኀበ ዕርገቱ 'at his ascension' (ኀበ 'at, where'; 'in the matter of' is the sense I give it in the English) (?). sentences.i: And again he said: 'And my horn will be exalted like that of the one-horned beast.' The horns, now, are interpreted as the kingdoms of the world; and as for what is called 'the one-horned one's', there is no one who opposes him in his kingdom, for he is the ruler of kings: whomever he wishes he overthrows, and whomever he wishes he sets up. As David said: 'And from the heavy (?) horns, from them he made you glad (?);
sentences.n: Psalm 92:10 (91:11 in the Septuagint), 'my horn shall be exalted like the unicorn's'. Here the author stops to interpret the symbol: አቅርንት 'horns' stand for መንግሥታተ ዓለም 'kingdoms of the world' (ይተረጐም 'is interpreted', tä-stem of ተርጐመ 'translate, interpret'), while the lone horn of the unicorn means one unrivalled kingdom. ዘይትበህልሂ is ዘ- + the tä-stem 'what is said' + -ሂ 'also'; ዘይትቃረኖ 'who opposes him' (ተቃረነ 'oppose' (?)). መላኬ ነገሥት 'ruler of kings' (መላኪ 'ruler', construct). ይስዕር 'overthrows' (ሰዐረ 'abolish, destroy'; the construction after ፈቀደ is hard) (?) and ይሠይም 'appoints' (ሠየመ). The closing quotation is Psalm 45:8 (44:9 in the Septuagint), the verse of the ivory palaces, whose 'ivory' (horn, tusk) lets it speak of horns. ክቡዳነ is the plural of ክቡድ 'heavy, weighty' in the construct/accusative form (the two are identical), not of ክቡር 'honoured' (whose plural is ክቡራን, used in the next unit); I keep 'heavy (?)', though the author's comment reads it as 'honoured'. ዘእምኔሆሙ is 'that (which is) from them'. ኣስተፈሥሐከ (with the printed variant ኣ for አ) is the ʾastä-stem አስተፈሥሐ 'make glad' (as in the published ወአስተፈሥሒዮሙ) in the 3ms perfect + -ከ 'you', so 'he made you glad'; the plural sense of the Psalm would need አስተፈሥሑከ (?). The ፤ ends the unit mid-sentence; the comment on the quotation follows.

sentences.l: And-this which-was-said from-honoured kings: 'You are-honoured and-you-rejoice,' saying. And-as prophesied Habakkuk while he-says: 'Horns in hands-his, and-he-set the-Beloved in-firmness-of power-his;
sentences.i: And this is what was said concerning the honoured kings: 'You are honoured and you rejoice' — that is what it says. And as Habakkuk prophesied, saying: 'Horns are in his hands, and he set the Beloved in the firmness of his power;
sentences.n: ዘተብህለ 'which was said' is the passive ተብህለ. The quotation 'you are honoured and rejoice' is the sense of the Psalm 45:8 line just given, read as addressed to the honoured kings; the ብሂል at the end is the same 'that is to say' marker. The next is Habakkuk 3:4, 'horns (rays) in his hands'; where the Greek tradition has 'love', the Geʿez has ፍቁረ, the accusative 'the Beloved' (ረሰየ 'set, make'). In the Hebrew the 'horns' are rays of light; the text takes them as symbols again. በጽንዐ ኀይሉ 'in the firmness of his power' (construct chain: ጽንዕ 'firmness', ኀይል 'power').

sentences.l: And-this-also saying: holder-of authority-of kings with-nails was-nailed, ʾərāḫu(?) he-who life-of all within-them held, that-which did Christ in-firmness-of power-his, the-Beloved, saying.
sentences.i: And this too it says: the holder of the authority of kings was nailed with nails, his ... (?), he who has the life of all, held fast within them (?); what Christ did in the firmness of his power is 'the Beloved' (?).
sentences.n: A hard final unit; the sense is the Christian reading of Habakkuk's 'horns in his hands': the nails of the cross in the hands of the crucified king. Source slip kept as printed: ነገሥ ፡ ት is one word, ነገሥት 'kings', split by a stray wordspace (so አኃዜ ስልጣነ ነገሥት, construct chain 'holder-of authority-of kings'). በቅንዋት ተቀነወ 'with nails he was nailed' (ቅንዋት 'nails', passive ተቀነወ). እራኁ is not a form I can parse; it may be a corrupt or rare word, left as 'his ... (?)'. ውስቴቶን is 'within them' (3fp), most likely the nails (ቅንዋት): I read ዘሕይወተ ኵሉ ውስቴቶን እኁዝ as 'he who has the life of all, held fast in them' (?); እኁዝ 'held, seized'. The final clause I read as 'what Christ did in the strength of his power — that is called the Beloved' (?). The trailing ፨ ፨ ፨ is the edition's closing ornament, kept on this unit.

glossary.ኀበ: ኀበ — to, toward, at; where (preposition / conjunction) · 'with, in the possession of' (ኢተርፈት ኀበ ኢዮርብዓም 'it did not remain with Jeroboam') · opening a title-like clause, 'how' or 'when' (ኀበ አስሐተቶ ለሰሎሞን ወለተ ፈርዖን 'how Pharaoh's daughter led Solomon astray') (?) · 'in the place of, as in' before a construct noun (ኀበ ነገረ ኢሳይያስ 'as in the word of Isaiah')
glossary.ነገሥ: ንጉሥ — ነገሥ-, first half of ነገሥት 'kings', split off by a stray wordspace (the second half is ት)
glossary.ን: እብን — -ን, second half of በአእባን 'with stones', split off by a stray wordspace · also the first half of ን ፡ ገስስ 'we touch' (ንገስስ), split by a stray wordspace (the second half is ገስስ) · also the first half of ን ፡ ጉሥኪ 'your king' (ንጉሥኪ), split by a stray wordspace (the second half is ጉሥኪ)
glossary.አልቦ: አልቦ — there is not, none (negative existential) · 'no, not so' as a reply (አልቦ እግዚኦ 'No, O lord', ch. 56)
glossary.አመ: አመ — on, at the time of, when (preposition / conjunction)
glossary.አሚረ: አሚር — day (noun, accusative; ኵሎ አሚረ 'all day')
glossary.አስተዳሎከ: አስተዳለወ — you prepared (2ms perfect, contracted) or 'he prepared for you' (3ms perfect + -ከ '2ms you'); the Psalm's sense favours 'you prepared' (ʾästä-stem, d-l-w) (?)
glossary.አቅርንትሰ: ቀርን — the horns, for their part (plural አቅርንት + -ሰ)
glossary.አኀዊከ: እኁ — your brothers (noun እኁ 'brother', plural አኀው, oblique stem አኀዊ- + -ከ '2ms your')
glossary.አኃዜ: አኀዘ — holder, seizer of (construct of agent noun አኃዚ, ʾ-ḫ-z; 'holder-of') (?)
glossary.ኣስተፈሥሐከ: አስተፈሥሐ — he made you glad (3ms perfect, ʾästä-stem causative, f-ś-ḥ + -ከ '2ms you'; initial ኣ is a printed variant of አ; the Psalm's plural sense would need አስተፈሥሑከ) (?)
glossary.እምሕዛእትከ: ሕዛእት — from your shoot, sprout (እም- + noun + -ከ '2ms your') (?)
glossary.እምኔሆሙ: እም — from them, out of them (preposition + 3mp suffix, stem እምኔ-)
glossary.እምኔከ: እም — from you (preposition እም with suffix -ኔከ '2ms')
glossary.እምአባሉ: አባል — from his limbs, members (እም- + noun 'limb, member' + -ሁ '3ms his') (?)
glossary.እምአፈ: አፍ — from the mouth of (እም- + noun, construct 'mouth-of')
glossary.እምክቡራን: ክቡር — from the honoured (እም- + adjective, plural ክቡራን)
glossary.እራኁ: እራኁ — unresolved (?) (form unknown; follows ተቀነወ as if an accusative of the part nailed, perhaps with -ሁ 'his') (?)
glossary.እስከ: እስከ — until, as far as (preposition) · እስከ — conjunction before a verb, 'until' (እስከ የዐዝዞ ማይ 'until the water seizes him')
glossary.እኁዝ: እኁዝ — held, seized (passive participle of አኀዘ, ʾ-ḫ-z)
glossary.እንዘ: እንዘ — while, whilst (conjunction) · 'while', also 'though' in contrast (እንዘ ክቡር ስምነ 'though our name was honored')
glossary.እደዊከ: እድ — your hands (noun, plural እደው, stem እደዊ- + -ከ '2ms your')
glossary.እድግት: እድግ — she-ass, ass (noun f.; እድግት is the feminine form)
glossary.ከመ: ከመ — that, so that; as · 'like' before a noun (ከመ ምድረ በረድ 'like a land of hail') · ከመ ኢ- 'that not, lest' (ከመ ኢትንገሥ ብእሲት 'that a woman not reign'; ከመ ኢታቅሞ 'that you not make him stay') · 'as when' before ዘ- or አመ (ከመ ዘ ዐገትዋ 'as when they besieged her') · 'like one who' before ዘ- + preposition (ከመ ዘቦቱ 'like one who has')
glossary.ኵሉ: ኵሉ — all, every, the whole of · 'everyone', used alone (ያፈቅር ኵሉ 'everyone loves') · ወበዝ ኵሉ 'and in all this' · ኵሉ ዘ- 'all who' (ኵሉ ዘሞአ 'all who conquered')
glossary.ወለዘፈቀደ: ዘ — and to whom he wished (ወ- 'and' + ለ- 'to' + relative ዘ- + 3ms perfect ፈቀደ 'wished')
glossary.ወለገፋዒ: ገፋዒ — and the oppressor (?) (ወ- + ለ- marking the object, doubled with ትንሥቶ; agent noun of ገፍዐ 'push, oppress')
glossary.ወሊቃነ: ሊቅ — and chiefs of (ወ- + plural construct ሊቃነ)
glossary.ወልደ: ወልድ — son (noun, construct state 'son-of') · accusative 'a son' (ወለደት ወልደ 'she bore a son')
glossary.ወልዲ: ወልድ — my son (noun + 1cs suffix -ī, written -ዲ; variant of ወልድየ) (?) · his son (noun + -ዲ for 3ms -ሁ 'his', Bezold's spelling; ለሰሎሞን ወልዲ 'to Solomon, his son'; ለአድራሚ ወልዲ 'Adrami, his son')
glossary.ወልድ: ወልድ — son (the Son) · a son in general (በረከተ አብ ላዕለ ወልድ 'a father's blessing upon a son')
glossary.ወሕፃናት: ሕፃን — and infants, children (ወ- + plural ሕፃናት)
glossary.ወምስፍና: ምስፍና — and rule, governorship (ወ- + abstract noun in -ና)
glossary.ወምግባሩ: ምግባር — and his work, deed (ወ- + noun + -ሁ '3ms his')
glossary.ወረሰየ: ረሰየ — and he made, set (ወ- + 3ms perfect, r-s-y)
glossary.ወበልዋ: ብህለ — and say to her (ወ- + 2mp imperative በሉ + -ዋ '3fs to her'; after ፃኡ ግበሩ, plural) (?)
glossary.ወበእንተ: በእንተ — and concerning, about (ወ- + preposition) · and on account of, because of (ወበእንተ እከዮሙ 'and because of their evil')
glossary.ወበከመ: ከመ — and as, and according as (ወ- 'and' + በ- + ከመ)
glossary.ወበደመ: ደም — and in the blood of (ወ- + በ- + noun, construct 'blood-of')
glossary.ወትትፌሣሕ: ተፈሥሐ — and you rejoice (ወ- + 2ms imperfect, tä-stem, f-ś-ḥ)
glossary.ወነቢያትሰ: ነቢይ — and the prophets, for their part (ወ- + plural ነቢያት + contrastive -ሰ)
glossary.ወኖምከ: ኖመ — and you slept (ወ- + 2ms perfect, G, n-w-m)
glossary.ወኢየሐጽጽ: ሐጸጸ — and it will not fail, lack (ወ- + ኢ- + 3ms imperfect, G, ḥ-ṣ-ṣ) (?)
glossary.ወእምአቅርንት: ቀርን — and from the horns of (ወ- + እም- + plural አቅርንት)
glossary.ወእምክቡዳነ: ክቡድ — and from the heavy (?) ones (ወ- + እም- + adjective ክቡድ 'heavy, weighty', plural ክቡዳነ in the construct/accusative form) (?)
glossary.ወዘንተኒ: ዝንቱ — and this also (ወ- + accusative ዘንተ + enclitic -ኒ)
glossary.ወዘይትበህልሂ: ብህለ — and what is said, called (ወ- + ዘ- relative + 3ms imperfect, tä-stem passive + -ሂ 'also')
glossary.ወየብቢ: አበበ — and let Jerusalem exult, cry out (?) (ወ- + 3ms jussive, unit's sense guessed; root unresolved, perhaps ʾ-b-b 'flourish'; the ending -ቢ is unexplained) (?)
glossary.ወየኀሪ: ኀረየ — and he will choose (ወ- + 3ms imperfect, G, ḫ-r-y)
glossary.ወየኀፅብ: ኀፀበ — and he washes (ወ- + 3ms imperfect, G, ḫ-ṣ-b)
glossary.ወይሰግዲ: ሰገደ — and they bow down (ወ- + 3mp imperfect, G, s-g-d, written with final -ዲ)
glossary.ወይቤሎ: ብህለ — and he said to him (ወ- 'and' + 3ms perfect ይቤ of b-h-l + -ሎ 'to him')
glossary.ወይብልዎ: ብህለ — and they say to him (ወ- + 3mp imperfect ይብሉ + -ሎ '3ms to him', joined as ዎ) · 'and they call him' (-ዎ '3ms him' as object: ወይብልዎ ፍቁር 'and they call him Beloved')
glossary.ወይትሌዐል: ተለዐለ — and may he be exalted (ወ- + 3ms jussive, tä-stem, root l-ʿ-l 'be high') · and it will be exalted, with a thing as subject (ወይትሌዐል ክብርከ 'and your glory will be exalted')
glossary.ወፍሡሓት: ፍሡሕ — and glad, bright (ወ- + adjective, fem. plural)
glossary.ወፍቁር: ፍቁር — and the Beloved (ወ- + passive participle of ፈቀረ 'love', used as a title)
glossary.ወፍቁርሰ: ፍቁር — and the Beloved indeed (ወ- + passive participle of ፈቀረ + -ሰ 'indeed, as for')
glossary.ውስተ: ውስተ — in, within, into · to, among (ወለአከ ውስተ ኵሉ ነጋድያን 'and he sent to all the merchants') · at (ውስተ መድረከ ኆኃቲሃ 'at the threshold of her doors') · upon, on (ውስተ ሐቌያቲሆሙ 'upon their hips'; ውስተ መንበረ አቡሁ 'on his father's throne')
glossary.ውእቱ: ውእቱ — he, it (3ms independent pronoun; also serves as copula 'is') · 'that' (demonstrative before a noun: ውእቱ ቃለ እግዚኣብሔር 'that word of God')
glossary.ዕርገቱ: ዕርገት — his ascension (noun f., from ዐርገ 'ascend' + -ሁ '3ms his')
glossary.ዕርገቶ: ዕርገት — his ascension (noun f., accusative + -ሁ '3ms his')
glossary.ዕርግ: ዐርገ — go up! (2ms imperative, G, ʿ-r-g; or possibly the noun ዕርግ 'ascent') (?)
glossary.ዘሕይወተ: ሕይወት — he who has the life (ዘ- 'he who, that which' + noun f. accusative 'life'; ዘሕይወተ ኵሉ 'he who has the life of all') (?)
glossary.ዘበረድ: በረድ — of hail (ዘ- 'of' + noun 'hail, ice'; ከመ ዘበረድ 'like (that) of hail') (?)
glossary.ዘተብህለ: ተብህለ — which was said (ዘ- relative + 3ms perfect passive of ብህለ)
glossary.ዘነዐወ: ነዐወ — he who prevailed (ዘ- relative + 3ms perfect, G, n-ʿ-w 'conquer') (?)
glossary.ዘእምኔሆሙ: እም — that from them (ዘ- relative 'that, which' + እምኔሆሙ 'from them')
glossary.ዘዕሴቱ: ዕሴት — he whose reward (ዘ- 'who, whose' + noun f. 'reward' + -ሁ '3ms his')
glossary.ዘየኀፅብ: ኀፀበ — who washes (ዘ- relative + 3ms imperfect, G, ḫ-ṣ-b)
glossary.ዘያነቅሆ: አንቀሀ — who wakes him (ዘ- relative + 3ms imperfect, ʾa-stem, n-q-h + -ሆ '3ms him')
glossary.ዘይመጽእ: መጽአ — who comes (ዘ- + 3ms imperfect, G, m-ṣ-ʾ)
glossary.ዘይትቃረኖ: ተቃረነ — who opposes him (ዘ- relative + 3ms imperfect, tä-stem, q-r-n + -ኦ 'him') (?)
glossary.ዘይወፅእ: ወጽአ — who comes out (ዘ- relative + 3ms imperfect, G, w-ṣ-ʾ)
glossary.ዘገብረ: ገብረ — what he did (ዘ- relative + 3ms perfect, g-b-r)
glossary.ዘጽኑሕ: ጽኑሕ — that which is firm, fixed (ዘ- relative + adjective/passive participle 'firm, abiding'; ይረክብ ዘጽኑሕ ሎቱ 'he finds what is fixed for him') (?)
glossary.ዘ፩ቀርኑ: ቀርን — he of one horn, the one-horned beast (ዘ- 'who' + numeral ፩, spoken አሐዱ (ʾähadu) 'one' + ቀርኑ 'his horn', ቀርን + -ሁ; the 'unicorn' of older English)
glossary.ይሠይም: ሠየመ — he appoints, sets up (3ms imperfect/subjunctive, G, ś-y-m)
glossary.ይረክብ: ረከበ — he finds, may find (3ms imperfect/subjunctive, G, r-k-b)
glossary.ይሰምይዎ: ሰመየ — they name him (3mp imperfect, G, s-m-y + -ዎ '3ms him')
glossary.ይስዕር: ሰዐረ — he abolishes, destroys (3ms imperfect/subjunctive, G, s-ʿ-r; the construction after ፈቀደ is hard) (?)
glossary.ይብል: ብህለ — he says (3ms imperfect, G stem, defective verb b-h-l)
glossary.ይተረጐም: ተርጐመ — it is interpreted (3ms imperfect ይተረጐም, passive/reflexive ተ-stem)
glossary.ይትሌዐል: ተለዐለ — he/it rises, is lifted (3ms imperfect, tä-stem, l-ʿ-l)
glossary.ይትቄበልዎ: ተቀበለ — they receive, welcome him (3mp imperfect, tä-stem, q-b-l + -ዎ '3ms him')
glossary.ይወርድ: ወረደ — it will descend (3ms imperfect, G, w-r-d)
glossary.ይጼዐን: ጾዐነ — he rides, carries (3ms imperfect, G, ṣ-ʿ-n)
glossary.ደቂቀ: ደቂቅ — sons, children (plural ደቂቅ, construct 'sons of')
glossary.ዳዊት: ዳዊት — David (proper name) · 'ዳዊት' also in ማኅፈደ ዳዊት 'tower (?) of David' (genitive after a construct) · also the young prince Menelik, styled David (እግዚእክሙ ዳዊት 'your lord David')
glossary.ጉሥኪ: ንጉሥ — -ጉሥኪ, second half of ንጉሥኪ 'your king', split off by a stray wordspace (the first half is ን)
glossary.ጸላኢ: ጸላኢ — enemy (noun; here Satan) · generic 'the enemy' in a psalm quotation (በእንተ ጸላኢ 'on account of the enemy')
glossary.ፃኡ: ወጽአ — go out! (2mp imperative, G, w-ṣ-ʾ)
glossary.ፈቀደ: ፈቀደ — he wished, wanted, desired (3ms perfect, G)
glossary.ፈድፋደ: ፈድፋደ — exceedingly, greatly (adverb) · 'especially' before a numeral (ፈድፋደ ፯ እምኔሆሙ 'especially seven of them') (?)
glossary.ፍቁረ: ፍቁር — the Beloved (passive participle of ፈቀረ, accusative; object of ረሰየ)
glossary.ፍቁር: ፍቁር — the Beloved, beloved (passive participle of ፈቀረ 'love', used as a title of Christ)
glossary.፻፯: ፻፯ — 107, spoken ምእት ወሰብዐቱ (məʾət wä-säbʿätu) 'one hundred and seven' (numeral)
